description: #182 Dice cmds via struct Summary of change: Designed a struct to implement dice commands Implementation details: `DiceCmdMeta` encapsulates information about a dice command. A map `map[string]DiceCmdMeta{}` stores all the `DiceCmdMeta` _objects_ and acts as a source of truth for all the commands. - `Eval` method contains business logic of the command. - if a command is not a valid DiceDB command then an error message is returned, earlier an invalid cmd was resolved as `PING`. This change is taken from Redis (refer img below) - few commands which requires `Client` struct are handled separately in `func executeCommand` as it was earlier. Handling them gracefully is a topic of discussion. - `Info` and `Docs` are kept placeholder and will be accomplished in #148 and #146 respectively. Redis reference: Note - changes in `core/eval.go` be better viewed in spit mode

comments.body: The Eval functions already have the docs in code comments. Can we add them here for completeness?

Assuming Docs is a link to documentation - 
We don't have a docs portal yet. Should we skip this atm? Any placeholders that we won't address in short term is smell for me.
Its easy enough to add it later in one go for all once we do something for docs.

the docs in code comments are different than the command should return, no ?
reference - https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/command-docs/

Skipping them atm does makes sense. Should I go with empty string or remove the `Docs` field altogther ?
I realize I have a habit of leaving placeholders in my code, and I need to get better at addressing them before submitting my PRs :/

We can either use the docs from Redis's website, or use the ones in our code comments. I guess they both refer to same behaviour in different language.
Whatever you chose i'd prefer having a meaningful info here rather than the placeholder.

I prefer removing whole rather than an empty string if its not doing anything atm.
Let me ask you first, how are you planning to use the docs attribute in future?
copied code comments to `Info` field, added new wherever they were missing and modified info of bloom filters commands.
